tasks.title: Durable job queue (lease/heartbeat/reclaim, window-aware, priority, cap)

prep.what: Build the durable PG-backed job queue: lease-based claim with heartbeat, expired-lease reclaim, work-window awareness, priority ordering, and per-client concurrency cap.
prep.understand: The sweeper (t21) and CI/deploy (t22) both submit jobs here — this is the M3 foundation that nothing in Phase 6 ships without. Key requirements: durable storage (PG jobs table), lease-based claim (SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), heartbeat to detect stalled jobs, reclaim of expired leases back to pending, window-awareness so agents don't fire outside work hours, priority lanes (high/med/low), and a per-client concurrency cap.
approach: Create `jobs` table migration: id, client_id, type, payload (jsonb), priority, status (pending/leased/done/failed), leased_at, lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at, attempts, created_at
Write JobQueue class with: claim(workerId) using SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, heartbeat(jobId, workerId), fail(jobId, error), done(jobId), reclaim() sweeping expired leases back to pending
Add window-awareness: claim() returns null if current UTC time is outside the client's work-window config
Add priority ordering: claim picks highest-priority, oldest-eligible pending job within the window
Add concurrency cap: claim() counts in-flight leased jobs per client, refuses to issue new lease if at cap
Test suite: lease lifecycle, heartbeat expiry → reclaim, priority ordering, window blocking, cap enforcement

tasks.title: Unprivileged CI lane + sensitive-path human gate

prep.what: Wire a GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs with zero repository secrets and blocks on sensitive-path PRs with a human-gate check.
prep.understand: The sweeper will open PRs; those PRs need CI green before auto-merge. CI on untrusted PRs must run with no secrets (never pull_request_target — that's the attack surface) and must pause for human review when a PR touches sensitive files (secrets patterns, CI config, deploy scripts). The no-secrets constraint means integration tests needing credentials must be mocked or skipped in CI.
approach: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml using `pull_request` trigger (NOT pull_request_target)
Add a build job: install, lint, compile, test — all must pass with ZERO repository secrets in env
Add a sensitive-paths-gate job: detect if changed files match *.env*, .github/workflows/**, deploy/**, secrets/**
If sensitive paths detected, post a check-run 'Human gate' in action_required state and stop — only a maintainer push/approval unblocks merge
Verify the gate fires on a test PR touching .github/workflows/ci.yml itself
resources: GitHub Actions: pull_request trigger security model vs pull_request_target
lib/sweeper.ts (sweeper PR flow — t23 depends on CI green as merge prerequisite)
